user.title: Connect to McIntosh MA352
user.description: Choose a local serial port or type a network serial server URL such as `socket://192.168.1.50:4001` (raw TCP), `telnet://192.168.1.50:4001` (telnet) or `rfc2217://192.168.1.50:4001`.

data_description.serial_port: Device path (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0, preferably a /dev/serial/by-id/ path) or socket://, telnet:// or rfc2217:// URL.
data_description.baudrate: Must match the RS232 baud rate set in the MA352 setup menu (default 115200). For a raw TCP or telnet serial server, the baud rate is configured on the server itself.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, or the amplifier did not respond. Check the port, cable and baud rate.
error.wrong_device: A device responded but it does not identify as an MA352.
error.wrong_amplifier: This port is connected to a different amplifier than the one configured.

data_description.max_volume: Volume commands from Home Assistant are limited to this level. Does not affect the front panel or remote.
